# `csharp_trailing_comma_in_singleline_lists`

Add a trailing comma after the last element even when the list is on one line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        var list = new List<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
        Register("curb", 42, true, "formatter");
    }

    private void Register(string a, int b, bool c, string d) { }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        var list = new List<int> { 1, 2, 3, };
        Register("curb", 42, true, "formatter");
    }

    private void Register(string a, int b, bool c, string d) { }
}
```
:::

::::

*Setting shown: `csharp_trailing_comma_in_singleline_lists = true`*

### `csharp_trailing_comma_in_singleline_lists = false`

```ini
csharp_trailing_comma_in_singleline_lists = false
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public void Run()
    {
        var list = new List<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
        Register("curb", 42, true, "formatter");
    }

    private void Register(string a, int b, bool c, string d) { }
}
```
